outcome: Acute Renal Failure (as an SMM indicator)
cohort: The study included all delivery hospitalizations from the 2019 National Inpatient Sample in the United States.
finding: Black birthing people experienced a substantially higher rate of severe maternal morbidity and preterm delivery compared to White birthing people, with the racial disparity in SMM being present across all weeks of gestation but largest at preterm gestations (22-33 weeks).
gest_age: All weeks of gestation for delivery hospitalizations, with specific analysis for 22-33 weeks and >=37 weeks.
